body:
It’s Skool and it’s S’Cool! And it’s FREE!

As parents of aspiring young actors, you’ve been there - scouring the internet for that one elusive piece of insider information that could give our child's career a much-needed boost. I mean, Have you ever found yourself endlessly scrolling through our Facebook group, struggling to locate that one tip you heard about securing an agent? The world of child acting is filled with so much uncertainty, but what if I told you there was a way to cut through the noise and get the trusted, valuable knowledge you've been seeking?

Child Actor 101: Embracing Evolution and Expanding Our Reach

Our community has always been about helping young actors shine – and that means giving you, the amazing parents and mentors, the best possible tools and support. Since Child Actor 101 started on Facebook, we've grown into something remarkable. But with growth comes new needs, and I've realized that to take things to the next level, we need a space built specifically for focused learning and organized knowledge.

Introducing Skool: Your Companion for Growth and Success

Think of Skool as an upgrade, but not replacement to our beloved Facebook experience.

Here's why you're going to love it:

  • Goodbye Information Overload, Hello Easy Answers: Skool is organized into clear categories. Need headshot advice? Tax questions? Self-tape tips? Find what you need in seconds, not hours.

  • No more hunting and pecking: Skool brings order to the chaos, empowering you to quickly deploy the knowledge you need to propel your child's career forward.

  • Courses That Empower You and Your Young Actor: We'll offer both FREE mini-courses and in-depth premium courses for those who want to go deeper. From understanding the business side of acting to helping young actors hone their craft, it's like a mini-university at your fingertips.

  • Engagement That's Actually Rewarding: Participating on Skool doesn't just feel good, it earns you points and rewards! Level up, unlock new tools, and gain recognition for your valuable contributions.

  • The Power of Premium: Our Premium Memberships like LEVEL UP! and VIP ACCESS give you insider access to live coaching calls, exclusive content, discounts on industry services, and more.

    It's an interactive learning experience built to transform your family's approach to the biz!

    Imagine having access to comprehensive courses taught by industry experts, covering everything from the fundamentals of the business to advanced acting techniques. Whether you're brand new to this world or a seasoned pro, Skool's classroom-style curriculum will take your skills to new heights.

Facebook + Skool = The Ultimate Support System

Our Facebook group is the heart of our community – the place for daily connection, updates, and celebrations. Skool is its focused, organized counterpart. Where Facebook is the bustling backstage, Skool is the focused rehearsal room. And it's not just about the intake of knowledge. Through gamified engagement, you can earn points, climb the ranks, and unlock a treasure trove of perks, tools, and insider opportunities. Think of it as leveling up, Child Actor 101 style.

Shake Your Algorithm!

Get re-inspired @ Child Actor 101 on Skool

What Skool Means For You

Let's get down to the real benefits:

  • Time Saved = More Time for What Matters: No more endless searches for those golden nuggets of wisdom. Find answers fast and get back to supporting your young star.

  • Knowledge = Confidence: Industry knowledge is power. Arm yourself with the insights that give you an edge.

  • Community + Learning = Growth on All Sides: Share your experiences, learn from others, and build skills together.

  • Exclusive Opportunities You Won't Find Anywhere Else: Open calls, casting notices, and chances to shine aren't just posted on Skool, they're targeted to our community.

  • Fun Challenges and Professional Feedback: Help your young actor rise to challenges, get noticed, and receive valuable feedback from industry experts.

  • Support Tailored to Where You Live: Our regional support hubs offer resources and knowledge specific to your location.

Premium Memberships Now Available

Consultations, Evaluations, Discounts, LIVE calls, Coaching & More. Oh My! LOOK HERE!!

This Is Just the Beginning

We're only scratching the surface of what Skool can become. Your ideas matter! What would make this platform truly indispensable? I want to hear your feedback and suggestions as we build something incredible together.

Let's Make Success A Team Effort

Child Actor 101 has always been about lifting each other up in this wild and wonderful industry. Embrace both Skool and our Facebook community to get the full spectrum of knowledge and camaraderie you deserve. Together, we'll help our young stars reach their fullest potential.

I can't wait to see you on Skool!

Corey Ralston

Founder, Child Actor 101
